title: Sensor inputs and plant surfaces are adopter declarations the sensors obey
statement: Every sensor MUST take its test roots, directories, paths, argv, and script names from the declared sensor inputs with an explicit --input overriding for one run only, an undeclared key, an unregistered kind, or a path outside the repository root MUST be refused before any sensor executes, and a sensor bound to a surface declared absent MUST emit skipped with the declaration as reason while a surface declared absent but present MUST produce a review finding.
rationale: ADR-SCR-0003 and ADR-SCR-0005 make sensor configuration part of the reference signal so a reading is reproducible from the repository alone.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
